settings.label: About the house
settings.text: Ananta means without end. Vastram means cloth. The name is a description of the work: a length of handwoven cloth with no seam, made on a loom that has been running in [town] for [how long], by weavers whose names we print on every piece.
settings.note: Ananta Vastram is a menswear house from Tamil Nadu. We make veshtis and the garments worn with them, in numbered editions, to order.

settings.title: Every piece carries a name
settings.text: The weaver's name is woven into the label and printed on the page. It is not a credit. It is the record of who made the cloth, kept where the buyer can see it.

settings.title: Numbered editions
settings.text: Each drop is a fixed, honest count. When the number is reached the piece is finished. It is not re-run.

settings.title: Made to order
settings.text: Nothing sits in a warehouse. A piece is begun when it is asked for, and you are told how long it will take.

settings.title: Worn by real people
settings.text: There are no models. Every photograph on this site is of someone who owns the piece, and we name them.

settings.title: One price
settings.text: The price is the price. There are no sales, no launch offers, and no marketplace listings.
